sections.title: Project list
sections.what: Draws the header with the title and count, then one link row per project with its number, name, and category. Rows with a repository get a marker.
sections.why: Likely reason: a dense list lets people compare every project quickly.
sections.watch_out: The count comes from the full list, so it updates on its own. Each row needs the number, name, and slug fields to be present.

summary: A plain list of every project. Each row links to the project's own page, and a small marker shows which projects have a repository.
purpose: Gives a complete, scannable index of all the work.
why: The file comment says this is the conventional way to reach all work, as an alternative to the visual layouts.
how: Shows a header with a title and project count. Then shows one row per project from the project data, with its number, name, category on wider screens, and a repository note where one exists.
inputs: An optional title (default Index) and the project list.
outputs: A list of links, one per project.
risks: The repository marker only checks that a repository link exists. It does not check that the link works.
debug: If a project is missing from the list, check its entry in the project data.
